topic: Neural Network Learning: The Intuition Behind Backpropagation
target_audience: University students (Computer Science or Data Science majors)

sections.title: The Learning Metaphor (0:00-0:45)
lecture_lines: They learn through trial and error.
animations: Display title: The Learning Metaphor in #FFFFFF.
Fade in a simple neural network diagram featuring the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/brain.svg] as the core processing hub.
Animate signal flow through the network connections originating from the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/brain.svg].
Change signal color to #FF5733 to represent activation.
Briefly flash the output node connected to the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/brain.svg] to indicate prediction.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Forward Pass (0:45-1:45)
lecture_lines: Each edge acts as a multiplier.
The final output is a prediction.
animations: Fade in layers with input values in #00FFFF.
Animate weights transforming signals between layers using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/microchip.svg].

sections.title: Quantifying the Mistake: Loss Function (1:45-2:30)
lecture_lines: Visualize it as a bowl landscape.
We aim for the lowest point.
animations: Show ground truth and prediction side by side.

sections.title: The Core Intuition: Backpropagation (2:30-4:15)
lecture_lines: Iterate until the error is minimal.
animations: Fade in error flow moving backward through network [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/network.svg].
Flash overall network to indicate refinement [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/network.svg].

sections.title: Convergence & Summary (4:15-5:00)
animations: Show error metric shrinking to zero using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/scale.svg].
Final high-level network summary appears using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/computer.svg].
